_comment: Qwen3-VL-8B LoRA. train_batch_size is OMITTED so DeepSpeed derives it and any --num_gpus works without editing this file.
_precision_comment: bf16, not fp16. Qwen3-VL ships bf16 weights and the vision tower's activations have the dynamic range that makes fp16 loss-scaling awkward. Every Ampere-and-later card supports bf16.
_zero_comment: Stage 3, and it is load-bearing here. 8.77 B parameters is 17.5 GB of bf16 weights -- more than a 24 GB card can hold alongside video activations. Stage 3 shards the PARAMETERS so each of N ranks holds 17.5/N GB. CLAUDE.md's warning applies: activations, gather buffers and fragmentation do NOT shard, so budget per GPU as weights/N + overhead, never in aggregate.
